title: Special teams standout Chazz Surratt will return to Seahawks on a one-year deal

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Special teams standout Chazz Surratt will return to Seahawks on a one-year deal
sources.description: The Seahawks are re-signing inside linebacker and core special teams player Chazz Surratt to a one-year deal, Aaron Wilson of KPRC reports.
